listings.description:
All-In-One Digital Planner for reMarkable Paper Pro 2026, 2027, 2028 and Any Year | Right or Left Handed | 14 Languages | Daily, Weekly, Monthly and Quarterly Planner | 100 Templates | Unlimited Downloads

⭐️ NEW: BUILT FOR YOUR HAND, EVERY YEAR ⭐️
This is no longer one fixed file. Your Etsy order number opens the planner's page on our site, where you choose right or left handed, where the reMarkable toolbar sits, the year, the week start, your language, your theme and your cover, and the planner builds as one hyperlinked PDF made for the Paper Pro's screen. Come back next year, or any year, type the same order number, pick the new year, and download the new edition. Lifetime yearly updates and unlimited downloads are included with your purchase, no repurchase ever. Bought this planner before? Your original order number opens the new page too.

🌍 NOW IN 14 LANGUAGES
English, Japanese, Korean, German, Spanish, French, Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, Italian, Portuguese, Dutch, Thai, Turkish and Russian. Month and day names, page labels and buttons, all in your language.

📌 Important Notes:

⭐RIGHT OR LEFT HANDED: the month tabs ride the edge your hand does not cover, so no tab hides under your palm.

⭐TOOLBAR SPACE: keep a blank strip on the left, on the right, or none, so the reMarkable toolbar never sits on the planner.

⭐This planner is designed for the reMarkable Paper Pro, featuring a fully colored interface (Pastel Rainbow or White).

⭐PORTRAIT ONLY

⭐It can still be used on previous reMarkable versions, but without colors.

⭐COLOURS ON E-INK: the reMarkable Paper Pro has a colour e-ink screen, which shows colour differently to a phone, tablet or computer. The theme colours in this planner look softer and more muted on the device than they do in these photos. That is the screen, not the file.

⭐You will receive a small PDF with the link to your planner page and the import instructions (desktop app, mobile app, my.remarkable.com or USB cable).

⭐ Take your productivity, creativity, and organization to the next level with the ultimate All-In-One Digital Planner for reMarkable. Designed specifically for digital paper users, this planner seamlessly integrates work, personal development, budgeting, and planning into one streamlined system. Featuring customizable sections, goal-setting pages, financial trackers, and note-taking templates, it helps you stay on top of your daily, weekly, and monthly tasks with ease.

✨ Key Features:

✔️ Designed for reMarkable Paper Pro (color version)
✔️ Usable on previous reMarkable versions (monochrome only)
✔️ Right or left handed, with room for the toolbar
✔️ 14 languages
✔️ Your name printed on the cover, or your own picture
✔️ 10 Custom Sections to tailor your planner
✔️ 10 Notepaper Templates in the notebook drawer, with two hundred more to add
✔️ 100 templates in 10 categories, 4 quarterly planners, a habit tracker and a monthly review
✔️ Yearly Updates - FREE, with unlimited downloads
✔️ Goal Tracking, Budgeting, and Productivity Tools
✔️ Eco-Friendly & Paperless

📆 Sections Included:

📝 Personal & Self-Care

Goal Tracker, Motivation Board, Habit Tracker, Daily Reflection, Gratitude Log, Fitness & Sleep Trackers, and more!

🎓 Education & Learning

Study Planner, Assignment Tracker, Class Information, Reading List, Research Projects, and Grade Tracker.

💰 Finance & Budgeting

Monthly Budget Planner, Expense Tracker, Debt & Savings Goals, Subscription Manager, and Investment Log.

🔮 Vision & Planning

Vision Board, Long-Term Goals, 5-Year Plan, Career & Relationship Vision Templates.

🏠 Household & Organization

Meal Planner, Chore Chart, Cleaning Tracker, Family Calendar, Grocery List, and Recipe Planner.

Project Planner, Task List, Meeting Notes, Inbox Tracker, Contact List, and Brainstorming Template.

Designed by an ADHDer for ADHD brains, this flexible digital planner helps you stay organized without the usual doom spirals & analysis paralysis. Purchase once and get LIFETIME access to all future editions, plus my Facebook Community so we can encourage each other to not fall off the bandwagon.

It evolves with you, supporting your creativity, motivation, and spontaneous nature without the pressure of "keeping up".

⌂ New templates for daily focus, self-care, chores, and more.

⌂ Plus, exclusive access to our new Rewards Generator and the Future ADHD Planner Users Community.

The planner works with Apple, Android, and Windows annotation apps. I recommend using apps like GoodNotes, Notability, Xodo, Flexcil, and Noteshelf.

Download the PDF file from Etsy.com OR click the Download button in your PDF.
Locate the file in your Files app or Downloads folder and Share to your preferred annotation app or import the file directly to GoodNotes, Notability, Penly, Kilonotes, Noteshelf or any annotation app you like!

• App Compatibility: Works with GoodNotes, Notability, Noteshelf, Penly, Samsung Notes, and more.
• Continuous Updates & Support: Improved regularly based on user feedback.
• Dedicated Customer Service: Reach out anytime for assistance or feedback.
